biological_accuracy.statement: The two subsets do not adjudicate whether the BC114 insertion is an ONT error, a Sanger error, or a biological difference, and they do not constitute the full HAC/SupHAC barcode benchmark.

software_correctness.statement: Two host-local workflow executions completed and emitted fail-closed REVIEW/FAIL verdicts, but the executed dirty-worktree source bytes were not frozen or hashed as a complete source snapshot. The BC115 alignment statistics also contain inconsistent read/alignment counts, which correctly made the contamination check unavailable. This packet therefore does not claim a reproducible software-correctness PASS.

technical_concordance.statement: The BC114 consensus was 99.8477929985% identical to the deposited Sanger record and retained one A→AT insertion with exact inserted-T support of 93.1818181818% (246/264). The historical 94.3181818182% value counted all insertion alleles and lengths at the anchor and is not used as an exact-allele claim. Because the same Sanger record selected the 283-read subset, this is a biased reference-conditioned agreement result, not an unbiased concordance estimate.

explicit_limitations: Only SupHAC data were acquired and run; HAC_data.zip was not acquired or executed.
Only BC115 exact-barcode and BC114 reference-conditioned subsets were executed; no complete per-barcode confusion matrix was produced.
BC114 read selection used the Sanger scoring reference and is therefore biased.
The executed repository source was a dirty worktree and was not frozen as a full content-addressed snapshot; current source is not substituted for historical bytes.
No container was used, so there is no image digest. Host package paths and versions are recorded instead.
No Nextflow trace file captured per-process CPU time or peak RSS.
The BC115 alignment stats mix read and alignment-record counts and made contamination evidence unavailable.
No independent adjudication determines the cause of the BC114 insertion.
Experimental profile thresholds remain unqualified and public_accuracy_validated is false.
The long-plasmid benchmark and the other scheduled public datasets were not run.

mapping_evidence.qualification: The subset scripts read barcode sequences directly from the Zenodo barcode workbook. Sanger record names were manually resolved from the Zenodo species workbook and then hard-coded in the recorded scripts; no machine-readable normalized mapping file was retained at acquisition time.

BC114_reference_conditioned.exact_barcode_stage: BC114 was extracted with the same exact barcode/reverse-complement edge rule while BC108-BC115 were scanned in one pass.
BC114_reference_conditioned.filter_script_text:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
r=Path('/tmp/biomodstack-phase2-public'); k='BC114'
keep=set()
for line in open(r/f'{k}.paf'):
    p=line.rstrip().split('\t'); qlen=int(p[1]); qs=int(p[2]); qe=int(p[3]); ident=int(p[9])/int(p[10]); cov=(qe-qs)/qlen
    if ident>=.9 and cov>=.7 and int(p[10])>=550: keep.add(p[0])
out=r/f'{k}.supHAC.reference-conditioned.fastq'; n=0
with open(r/f'{k}.supHAC.exact-barcode.fastq') as f,open(out,'w') as w:
    while True:
        h=f.readline()
        if not h: break
        seq=f.readline(); plus=f.readline(); qual=f.readline(); rid=h.split()[0][1:]
        if rid in keep: w.write(h+seq+plus+qual); n+=1
BC114_reference_conditioned.selection_bias: The Sanger record used for later agreement scoring was also used for read selection. This is intentionally reference-conditioned and cannot estimate unbiased biological accuracy or unbiased concordance.
BC114_reference_conditioned.selection_rule: Primary minimap2 map-ont alignment identity >= 0.90, query coverage >= 0.70, and aligned block length >= 550 bp.

BC115_exact_barcode.selection_rule: Exact BC115 or reverse-complement occurrence in concatenated first 140 and last 140 read bases.
